description: Which integrations can I use, and with which right? Lists the company integrations of the current tenant (also those I have no access to, so I can request it) with my right (none | read | write | manage) and my own PRIVATE integrations. read = only reading tools, write = also changing tools, manage = change credentials and grant access. Admins additionally see that private integrations of other members exist (provider and owner only).
name: list_my_integrations
